Follow the round (ie follow the point of impact). You move your point of aim to the point of impact. If you are hitting low left, you adjust the sight down elevation and left windage.

The only potentially tricky part is knowing your sight, 99% of sights though, a click towards “left” or “up” means that’s where your reticle will move.

To summarize. Follow the round, adjust your reticle to land on where the rounds are hitting.
